summary: This lecture tells how Umar ibn al-Khattab embraced Islam three days after Hamzah. The ustaz describes Umar as a 25 or 26-year-old of great strength, easily swayed by Abu Jahal, yet sympathetic to Layla who was migrating. The Prophet SAW had prayed that Islam be strengthened with one of the two Umars. Umar, intent on killing the Prophet SAW, overheard him reciting Surah Al-Haqqah at the Kaaba at night and was captivated. On his way with a sword, Nu'aim told him his sister Fatimah and her husband Sa'id had embraced Islam. Umar attacked them and struck his sister until she bled, then felt remorse, read the opening of Surah Taha and his heart softened. He went to Dar al-Arqam and pronounced the shahada, then announced it to Abu Jahal and prayed openly at the Kaaba. The Prophet SAW called him Al-Faruq.
keyPoints: The Prophet SAW prayed that Islam be strengthened by one of the two Umars, and Allah chose Umar ibn al-Khattab.
Umar overheard the recitation of Surah Al-Haqqah at the Kaaba and was moved though still angry.
Nu'aim told Umar that his sister Fatimah and her husband Sa'id had embraced Islam, so Umar went to attack them.
Umar regretted hurting his sister, read Surah Taha and his heart softened.
Umar embraced Islam at Dar al-Arqam and the Prophet SAW called him Al-Faruq.

chapters.title: Hamzah is calm as Umar arrives
chapters.summary: The ustaz opens with Umar arriving with a sword at the secret house, and Hamzah saying let him in.

chapters.title: Opening and the ten days of Dhul Hijjah
chapters.summary: The ustaz gives thanks and mentions the first ten days of Dhul Hijjah that Allah loves most, and recalls Hamzah.

chapters.title: The young and mighty Umar
chapters.summary: Umar was 25 or 26, very tall and strong with a deep voice, and heard Abu Jahal's bad stories about the Prophet SAW.

chapters.title: Layla and Umar
chapters.summary: Umar who persecuted Muslims sympathised with Layla packing to migrate and prayed for their safety.

chapters.title: The Prophet's prayer for one of the Umars
chapters.summary: The Prophet SAW prayed that Islam be strengthened by one of Amr ibn Hisham or Umar ibn al-Khattab.

chapters.title: Umar's family
chapters.summary: His brother Zaid and sister Fatimah had secretly embraced Islam, and Umar wanted to kill the Prophet SAW after Abu Jahal's urging.

chapters.title: The Kaaba at night
chapters.summary: Umar looked for his drinking friends but found none, so went to the Kaaba and saw the Prophet SAW praying facing Jerusalem.

chapters.title: Hearing Surah Al-Haqqah
chapters.summary: Umar crept behind the Kaaba's cloth and heard his recitation, and the verses answered his thoughts that he was a poet or soothsayer.

chapters.title: Umar goes out with a sword
chapters.summary: Umar, angry, went out with his sword, but Nu'aim told him his sister Fatimah had embraced Islam to stop him.

chapters.title: Fatimah's house
chapters.summary: Khabbab taught the Quran secretly at Fatimah and Sa'id's house and hid when Umar came.

chapters.title: Umar strikes and regrets
chapters.summary: Umar struck Sa'id and knocked Fatimah until she bled, then felt ashamed and calmed down.

chapters.title: Surah Taha
chapters.summary: Umar bathed and made wudu before touching the pages, then read Surah Taha stating the Quran was not sent down to cause hardship.

chapters.title: Khabbab and Dar al-Arqam
chapters.summary: Khabbab came out and told of the Prophet's prayer, then Umar sought the Prophet SAW at Dar al-Arqam, in Abu Jahal's own area.

chapters.title: Umar pronounces the shahada
chapters.summary: Hamzah was calm, the Prophet SAW pulled Umar and asked him, then Umar pronounced the shahada and all shouted takbir.

chapters.title: Jamil, Abu Jahal and prayer at the Kaaba
chapters.summary: Umar told the gossip Jamil and Abu Jahal, then two lines led by Hamzah and Umar prayed openly at the Kaaba.

chapters.title: Al-Faruq and the lessons
chapters.summary: The Prophet SAW called Umar Al-Faruq. The ustaz concludes that even a distant person can embrace Islam and strengthen it.

dalil.context: It is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
dalil.translation: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-

dalil.context: Nor the word of a soothsayer.
dalil.translation: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!

dalil.context: The ustaz says Umar read the opening of Surah Taha.
We did not send down the Quran to you to cause you distress.
dalil.translation: It was not to distress you [Prophet] that We sent down the Quran to you,
The Prophet SAW prayed that Allah strengthen Islam with one of the two Umars whom He loves most.
dalil.context: The ustaz mentions this supplication, which Khabbab repeated to Umar. He does not name a narrator or source.

dalil.translation: The ustaz mentions that if Umar walked down an alley where Satan was, Satan would leave and take another way.
dalil.context: The ustaz mentions this story as a sign of Umar's firmness. He does not name a narrator or source.

people.role: A mighty youth who embraced Islam, called Al-Faruq
people.context: Aged 25 or 26, he meant to kill the Prophet SAW but embraced Islam at Dar al-Arqam and later became the second caliph.
Incited Umar to kill the Prophet SAW and struck his door when Umar announced his Islam.
Calm when Umar came with a sword and led one line to the Kaaba.
Was packing to migrate when Umar asked and prayed for them.
Was struck by Umar until she bled while trying to protect her husband.
A companion promised paradise, struck by Umar but reminding him Islam might be true.
Hid in a cupboard then came out and told Umar of the Prophet's prayer.
Told Umar about his sister to stop him killing the Prophet SAW.
About 13 or 14 years old, his house became the secret centre.
Spread the news of Umar's Islam.
Said the day Umar embraced Islam was the best day in Mecca.
Not yet Muslim, would embrace Islam thirteen years later.

sirah.era: The sixth or seventh year: Umar embraces Islam
sirah.summary: This lecture covers Umar ibn al-Khattab hearing Al-Haqqah, discovering his believing sister, reading Taha and embracing Islam.

events.label: Layla
events.title: Umar meets Layla
events.desc: He asked and prayed for their safety.

events.label: Al-Haqqah
events.title: Umar hears Surah Al-Haqqah
events.desc: He crept behind the Kaaba's cloth and was captivated.

events.label: Nu'aim
events.title: Nu'aim stops Umar
events.desc: He told Umar about his believing sister.

events.label: The blow
events.title: Umar attacks his sister
events.desc: He struck Sa'id and knocked Fatimah until she bled.

events.label: Taha
events.title: Umar reads Surah Taha
events.desc: His heart softened and he wanted to meet the Prophet SAW.

events.label: Shahada
events.title: Umar pronounces the shahada
events.desc: He became a Muslim before the Prophet SAW at Dar al-Arqam.

events.label: Abu Jahal
events.title: Umar tells Abu Jahal
events.desc: Abu Jahal was furious and struck his door.

events.label: Kaaba
events.title: Open prayer at the Kaaba
events.desc: Two lines led by Hamzah and Umar marched to the Kaaba.

lessons.title: Do not fight without understanding
lessons.body: Umar was hostile because of Abu Jahal's stories until he heard the recitation himself.

lessons.title: The Prophet's prayer is answered
lessons.body: Allah chose Umar as the answer to his prayer to strengthen Islam.

lessons.title: Shame at striking a woman
lessons.body: Umar was ashamed when he struck his sister until she bled.

lessons.title: Purifying before touching the Quran
lessons.body: Fatimah told Umar to bathe and make wudu before touching the Quran pages.

lessons.title: The Quran softens hearts
lessons.body: The reading of Taha changed Umar, who had intended to kill the Prophet SAW.

lessons.title: Receiving an enemy firmly and gently
lessons.body: The Prophet SAW pulled Umar to sit on his knee and asked him, and Umar embraced Islam.

lessons.title: Guidance is never impossible
lessons.body: Someone who seems impossible to embrace Islam can become a strength for it.

lessons.title: The best ten days of Dhul Hijjah
lessons.body: The first ten days of Dhul Hijjah are the days Allah loves most all year.

lessons.title: Satan fears firmness
lessons.body: It is said Satan avoids the path Umar walks.

glossary.meaning: The one who separates truth from falsehood, Umar's title from the Prophet SAW.
The 69th surah the Prophet SAW was reciting when Umar overheard.
Melodious poetry like a song, which led Quraysh to accuse him of being a poet.
The secret house where the Prophet SAW taught, in Abu Jahal's area.
A successor to the Prophet SAW as leader. Umar became the second caliph.
The month of Hajj, whose first ten days Allah loves most.
